title: Logozusatz / Horizontal centered

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Sequence the parent mark before the business descriptor so viewers understand who speaks and which part of the organization is involved.
strategic_value: A stable DB signature followed by a suffix can preserve masterbrand recognition in a specific business context.
demonstration: The red DB logo resolves, then the black Zusatz descriptor appears to its right in a centered horizontal lockup.
practical_value: Compare this centered lockup with the left-aligned and vertical variants for the available composition.

content_islands.name: Parent mark
content_islands.spec: Reveal the red DB mark first.

content_islands.name: Business descriptor
content_islands.spec: Keep the black Zusatz text subordinate to the DB mark and reveal it after the mark.

reference_purposes.Application: The source presents this arrangement as a business/product suffix variant.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying text permits the suffix when communication relates exclusively to a particular business or product area.
